title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A count it could not know
summary: The usage badge next to a Gradle dependency read the project imports with a ceiling of 4000 files. A project of 5088 sources walked past it, and the badge still printed a number.

highlights.title: Numbers you can trust
highlights.description: Of the 29 dependencies that got a figure on a real project, 22 were undercounted and up to 3 read 0 imports while being used.

highlights.title: A question mark instead of a guess
highlights.description: Past the new ceiling of 20000 files the badge shows ? imports, and a line is never greyed out as dead on an incomplete sweep.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The import sweep behind the dependency badge reached only the first 4000 source files, so the figure was wrong on any project bigger than that.
junit-jupiter-api, with 33 real imports, was among the dependencies shown at 0 imports and greyed out as dead.
The sweep costs 118 ms instead of 81 ms on that project, once per 20 second window and only while a Gradle file is open.
